source: I want to create a game on an island, where the goal is to find 5 coconuts.\nGenerate a 3d scene of an island. It has nice beaches, a volcano in the middle, and jungle trees all around. It has a few cabans.

image_prompt.text: Hidden cutouts among the jungle undergrowth and volcanic rock where a coconut can be tucked out of plain sight
A volcano rising in the middle of the island, visible from anywhere on it, giving the wandering a centre to orient by
A board where the coconuts found so far are posted and tracked
An island - a self-contained landmass ringed by water, with sandy beaches all around its perimeter
Jungle trees covering the island around the volcano
A few cabanas scattered on the island

layout_placement.text: Five coconuts hidden around the island - the beaches, the jungle, the volcano slopes - and finding all five is the goal
The found-coconut count tracked at the board

notes: The count - exactly five coconuts - lives only inside the collectible text; there is no count field.
No option describes the island landmass, its beaches, or the tree cover, so they are carried as free text in image_prompt.

open_questions.ask: What look - bright cartoon tropical, or a realistic natural island? You described the place but not the style.
What happens when all five coconuts are found - does the round end, or does it reset?

coverage_missing.ask: Does finding all five end the game?
How long should crossing the island take - half a minute, or several?
Are the coconuts in fixed hiding places, or scattered randomly each round?

answers.ask: What look - bright cartoon tropical, or a realistic natural island? You described the place but not the style.
answers.answer: Use a bright cartoon tropical look, with colorful beaches, stylized jungle trees, and a friendly volcano.

answers.ask: What happens when all five coconuts are found - does the round end, or does it reset?
answers.answer: When all five coconuts are found, the round ends.
